card.band: 8h. Frontier agents deliver the main CRUD operations, but pagination, validation error text, filters and the long tail of operations differ. Buckets by operation group. A weaker model covers create/describe only.
card.cheat: Returning canned responses fails stateful sequences and error cases. Hidden tests use only the boto3 API.
card.grading: Hidden pytest cases drive the mock through boto3 clients in-process: success paths, pagination, error codes, cross-region and account isolation, and tags. Hundreds of cases. The existing suite for neighbouring services is the regression gate.
card.reference: Our own implementation, expected 1500+ lines plus tests, written from the public AWS API model JSON that botocore ships.
card.task: /app ships a history-less moto snapshot. From the repo's open issues for unimplemented APIs, the agent adds one missing multi-resource service family (for example a currently unimplemented service with 25+ operations). It needs a model, URL routing, response serialisation, tagging, pagination, error codes and state persistence across backends.
card.title: Add a mock AWS service with boto3-level behaviour to moto

history: Adding a moto service is formulaic: there is an in-repo scaffold, and botocore models give the shapes. Weaker models likely keep up. The premise is not_found: no wholly absent service with 25+ operations was confirmed, and the service is not pinned. Error text and pagination details come from our ow
source_notes: SWE-smith profile (python): its suite runs in a container; test command: the language default. The repo is used by a SWE-bench-family dataset.

facts.claim: moto repo at release 5.2.4 exists; CHANGELOG top entry is 5.2.4 (New Services: Bedrock AgentCore), so master has no later release at fetch time
Docs list 164 AWS services as supported (excludes two non-service entries)
A wholly unimplemented service with 25+ operations exists in the coverage table (the seed's premise for the task's service choice)

Coverage table: visible services (about 46 of about 164 headings, first 100k of 355k chars) all have at least one implemented op; many have 25+ unimplemented ops (e.g. apigateway ~46, cloudfront ~160, connect ~300), i.e. partial rather than absent
Open GitHub issues for unimplemented APIs exist as a selection pool (seed says 100 open PRs, issues not enumerated)
Dated public evidence that frontier agents partially succeed or fail at adding a moto service

full_card.band: 8h tier; scope = one 25+ op family; buckets by operation group (create/describe first, then list/pagination, filters, tags, error text, cross-region isolation); weaker model stops after create/describe
full_card.build_cost: About 3 days: write 1500+ line reference plus boto3 hidden tests and run neighbour regression suites
full_card.deliverable: New moto service backend for one multi-resource AWS family (25+ ops): model, routing, XML/JSON serialisation, tags, pagination, error codes, state per account/region
full_card.gates_anticheat: Canned responses fail stateful and error cases; hidden tests boto3-only; close edits to tests/conftest, pinned moto in site-packages, and wrapping external mock servers (verify no other moto install in image)
full_card.grading_surface: Hidden pytest via boto3 in-process: hundreds of cases over operation groups; plus existing neighbour-service suites as regression gate
full_card.local_fit: Pure Python, CPU only, fits 8 cores / 16 GB; full moto suite is large (1156 test files) so regression gate must be scoped to neighbours
full_card.lookup: No later moto release adds a service (master CHANGELOG top is 5.2.4); moto code is famous so outline recall is possible, exact code for the new family is not public at this base
full_card.provenance: moto 5.2.4 (head dd8bf40), Apache-2.0, pushed 2026-10-19, 1156 test files; history-less snapshot at base is the intended /app
full_card.reference: Our own implementation written from botocore service-model JSON, expected 1500+ lines plus tests; not a public artifact for the pinned service
full_card.ships: Python moto package; one pinned service family must be picked and fixed in the card before build (seed leaves choice to agent)
full_card.similarity: l0 neighbours: S-im-093 0.283, S-im-088 0.242, S-im-073 0.231 (internal seeds, not public tasks); public s3-clone [SWE-Marathon] 0.156 shares AWS-mock theme but different deliverable (standalone clone vs moto backend)

Band.why: 8h band is plausible for a 25-op family, but no dated public evidence, so capped at 3; the frontier partial-success curve is unverified.

Build.why: About 3 days for reference plus hidden tests plus neighbour regression.

Fit.why: Pure Python CPU job; fits the box, but the full moto suite is heavy and must be scoped.

Hor.why: Model, routing, serialisation, tags, pagination, errors and state across backends is sustained multi-module work.

Multi.why: Operation groups give steady partial-credit buckets.

Nov.why: Closest public task s3-clone (0.156) shares the AWS-mock theme but has a different deliverable; internal neighbours are seeds, not public tasks.

Real.why: Real upstream repo at a named release, Apache-2.0, active (pushed 2026-10-19).

Ref.why: Our own reference from botocore models; complete and checkable for a pinned service, but not a public complete implementation.

Seal.why: Reference and hidden tests are ours and not in the image; moto patterns are recallable in outline, so sealing is partial.

Surf.why: Hundreds of boto3-driven hidden cases over operation groups; not thousands or an unlimited generator.

spike_plan.kill_if: No entirely absent 25+ op family exists (only partial services), or baseline neighbour suites are red, or the image already ships another moto.
spike_plan.pass_if: Baseline neighbour suites green; one pinned family is entirely absent from moto and has 25+ ops in botocore; in-process boto3 test is deterministic over 3 runs.
steps: In a networked throwaway container, clone getmoto/moto at dd8bf40 and pip install -e . with test extras; confirm the image has no other moto installed.
Run the baseline pytest for two neighbour services and time it; expect green.

Pick ONE candidate family and pin it in the card: list its botocore operations and confirm no moto/<service> package exists (entirely absent, 25+ ops). The coverage table shows partial services, so an absent one must be checked.
Write a 3-op stub (create, describe, list with pagination) and a boto3 in-process pytest for it; confirm it runs in-process and is deterministic over 3 runs.
Check the cheat paths: canned response fails a stateful sequence, and error codes are asserted from the botocore model.
Record the time to build the stub and the regression suite result.

v1.summary: The moto 5.2.4 base is real, Apache-2.0 and sealable, and no later release adds a service, so lookup is clean, but the seed leaves the service family to the agent and the coverage table shows the visible services are partially implemented rather than absent. The card passes all gates only once one fully absent 25+ operation family is pinned; I left kill_code empty on that condition and scored Band at 3 for lack of dated evidence.

v2.note: Adding a moto service is formulaic: there is an in-repo scaffold, and botocore models give the shapes. Weaker models likely keep up. The premise is not_found: no wholly absent service with 25+ operations was confirmed, and the service is not pinned. Error text and pagination details come from our own reference, so grading on them is hand-rolled. The s3-clone public neighbour is also AWS-mock themed.
